hints.title: Count Order Inversions
hints.text: In a sorted and rotated array, there can be at most one index i where nums[i] > nums[(i + 1) % n].

hints.title: Include Wrap-Around Check
hints.text: Check all adjacent pairs including the wrap-around comparison between the last and first element.

hints.title: Evaluate Condition
hints.text: If count of drops is <= 1, return true; otherwise return false.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space single circular pass evaluates drop count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses modular indexing to count decreases across the array boundary.
